title: test(ui): live e2e signs in a read-not-write member and asserts the Console refuses coherently (#27552)

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：实时界面测试（Live E2E）以前只用管理员登录，现在多了一个「能看不能改」的普通成员身份，并新增一条场景：成员打开管理员的询价记录时，编辑框只读并写明「你没有权限编辑这条记录」、没有保存按钮，记录页上没有「编辑」按钮也没有双击编辑；管理员对照组能编辑同一条记录并保存成功。
- 为什么改：权限类缺陷（#27138、#27146、#27147）是 Console 和服务端之间最常见的合并后才发现的问题，管理员什么都能过，所以原来的实时测试看不到这一类。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试文件和 nightly 列表里的一项，不改产品代码、不改种子数据、不进 CI 必跑车道；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts`（三步断言）、`ui/e2e/live/member.ts`（管理员建成员并登录）、`ui/package.json` 的 `test:e2e:live:nightly` 一行。
- 两分钟验证：起实时栈后在 `ui/` 跑 `pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.live.config.ts read-only-member-record.spec.ts`，预期 1 passed（本地约 38 秒）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27552

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **A second, non-admin identity for the live harness** (`ui/e2e/live/member.ts`). `signInMember(adminRequest, permissionSet)` has the admin create a member holding one of the showcase's own permission sets through `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` (password, `mustChangePassword: false`, `permissionSet`), signs it in, and returns a storageState with the same two halves `global-setup.ts` writes for the admin (the API-origin cookie and the APP-origin `auth-session-token`). One member per set at a fixed address, so a re-run against a long-lived backend reuses it (`USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL` is accepted). The state is returned, not written to disk, so no path needs rooting.
- **A new live spec** (`ui/e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts`). The member holds `showcase_manager`: on `showcase_inquiry` (OWD `private`) it reads org-wide and writes only its own rows. The admin creates an inquiry, so the member may read it and may not write it: a row verdict, the shape #27138 had. In order:
  1. premise through the server: the member's GET answers 200, its PATCH answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`;
  2. as the member, `?form=ID` opens the edit dialog with `closed-affordance-notice` visible, `name`/`email`/`company`/`message` disabled and no submit button in `modal-form-footer`; the record page under it has no Edit button and no inline-edit pencils; the member's browser sent no non-GET request to the object;
  3. control, as the admin: the same record page offers Edit and the pencils (the same locators step 2 finds absent), the same form has no notice and an enabled field, and a save through the form answers 2xx and the record reads back the new value.
- **Nightly only** (`ui/package.json`): the spec joins `test:e2e:live:nightly`. Per the card's promotion rule it moves to `test:e2e:live:ci` only after 3/3 consecutive green on the live pair plus 5/5 of the enlarged allowlist, inside #27550's 2-minute budget.

## Tests

Live stack in this container: this tree's built CLI serving `examples/app-showcase` through `ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, port 4127), the Console from `ui/apps/console` on vite (port 5327) proxying to it.

<details><summary>What was measured before writing the spec</summary>

- `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email` on the dev server answers 403 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` (audience posture `invite_only`), so a sign-up step in the global setup cannot make the member; the admin's create-user door can.
- As the `showcase_manager` member: GET of an admin-owned inquiry 200, PATCH 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` ("You do not have access to this record…"); PATCH of a project 403 (object-level, from the `everyone` baseline's read-only grant).
- Console as the member on that inquiry: header shows `More actions` and `Timeline` only (no Edit), the `⋯` menu holds Refresh / Add to favorites / Share (no Delete), no inline-edit pencils; `?form=ID` draws the dialog read-only with "You don't have permission to edit this record. The fields are read-only." and Cancel / Close only. As the admin: Edit, six pencils, Delete in the menu, the dialog editable with Update.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card offered two ways to make the member: a seeded member in `examples/app-showcase`, or a sign-up step in `global-setup.ts` with a second storageState. Sign-up is closed on the dev server (measured above), and a seed change is not needed: the admin create-user door with the showcase's existing `showcase_manager` set gives the member and the read-not-write row. So neither `global-setup.ts` nor the showcase changed. The member is made by the one spec that needs it rather than by the global setup, so the required `Live E2E UI` lane, which shares the global setup, pays nothing for it while the spec is nightly-only. It also keeps this PR off `global-setup.ts`, which sibling #27551 may touch. When the spec is promoted, moving `signInMember` into the global setup is a one-call change if a second spec wants the identity.
- `ui/e2e/live/member.ts` is a new file beside the spec, under the claimed `ui/e2e/live/` surface; it is the "second identity" half of the card's Task 1 kept reusable for the next access scenario (#27146 / #27147 shapes).
- Scope chosen for the record: a ROW verdict (object allows edit, this row refuses), because that is the #27138 escape. The object-level refusal (the member's read-only grant on `showcase_project`) was measured and left out of the spec; the existing unit suites already pin the object-level form lock (objectui#11000).
- Durations: about 38 s per run against the vite dev server here, including the cold compile of three page loads. That alone would take a third of #27550's 2-minute budget, so the promotion decision should re-measure it on the CI lane's `vite preview` build.
- No published package changes (`ui/package.json` is the private workspace root), so no changeset.
- Harness PR step skipped: per the dispatch order, this PR carries no assignee and no review request.
